All Additional CPFCs (ZONES) /Director (NATRSS)
All RPFCs in charge Regional/Sub Regional! Offices.

Subject: Arrangement for using services of officers/ officials posted in the Official
Language Wing on tour basis for operative efficiency - regarding.

Dear Madam/Sir,

References have been received from various field offices from time to time regarding
shortage of officers and staff in the Official Language Wing. Similar requests have also been
received from field offices when Parliamentary Committee on Official Language propose to visit
the offices that have vacancies in the cadre of Official Language.

2. A redistribution of responsibilities amongst the existing officers and staff in this wing is
the suggested mechanism, The officers and officials working in this wing under the contro! of
Addl. CPFC (Zones) need to be utilized for discharging additional responsibilities on tour basis
in offices where their services are warranted, It is in this background and in order to meet the
requirements of various offices in this area, it has been decided to authorize Addl, CPFC
(Zones) to utilize the existing manpower available in this cadre under their jurisdiction in such
a way that the work related to Official Language in none of the offices goes unattended.

3. In cases of detailing the officers/staff on tour basis, the tour programme shall be
approved by the Addl. CPFC (Zones) in exercise of the revised powers delegated to them under
Sl. No. 10 of the “Delegation of Powers to Addl. CPFCs (Zones) and Addl. CPFC (HR) under the
Head - “Allowing tour to officers and staff” (Original Item No. 95). Further, the tour programme
of the concerned officers/officials need to be proposed by the senior most officer of the Official
Language Wing working under the administrative control of the Addl, CPFC (Zones) on need
basis. Such delegated powers should be sparingly used by the Addl. CPFC (Zones) at the time
of need and not as a routine.

4. Accordingly, all the Addi. CPFC (Zones) are requested to work out a mechanism for
optimum use of the existing officers and officials in the Official Language Wing so that the work
related to Official Language does not suffer in any of the offices under their jurisdiction under
intimation to Head Office.

Yours faithfully,

Lee.

(P.K. UDGATA)
Addl. CPFC (HQRS)
